name: Welltower
outlook:
What Welltower says to expect

  • Full year 2026: normalized FFO per shareWe also increased the guidance range of full year normalized FFO attributable to common stockholders to a range of $6.47 to $6.53 per diluted share from the previous range of $6.36 to $6.44.
  • Full year 2026: net income per shareNet income attributable to common stockholders guidance has been revised to a range of $3.31 to $3.37 per diluted share from the previous range of $3.11 to $3.19.
  • 2026: general and administrative expensesWe anticipate general and administrative expenses to be approximately $267 million to $272 million, inclusive of stock-based compensation expense of approximately $60 million.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 26, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
